sourceFindings.finding: Current snapshot always full-inspects; retention age/daily policy has no explicit last-full-good pin; handler owns five-minute scheduling. D2 not implemented.
sourceFindings.design: Extract policy/service returning quick/full reason and result. Persist last successful full timestamp, database_id and artifact name only after verified full success; keep pinned full until replacement succeeds, including external retention. Define overdue as24h wall elapsed since success, trigger next startup/operation after downtime; no background SLA. Required full overrides throttle; failed full never advances marker. Cache keyed database_id+verified blob hash and reset on adopt/restore/source change; full bypasses cache. Quick success never labeled full.

Import schema3 correction metadata deliberately without destructively migrating readonly external source. Implement exact6row v10/v11/v16/v19/v20/v21 oracle,409,identity-switch,legacy and correction-gap tests.

designSequence: Root records whole-local L1-L8 coverage and explicit requirement/proof rows, source-backed SPEC/ADR and exact WO; independent admission+fresh controls/doctor before any BUILD.
First establish true native print/control capability and baseline V1; keep required outcomes OPEN if unavailable. This is finite evidence-feasibility work, not permission to downgrade acceptance.
One source owner for schema/save/backup/maintenance server contracts; separate UI worker consumes locked API/contracts. Implement D2/D3/D4 and U changes in dependency order, preserve PNI guards.

Consolidate review once, reviewer-local determined fixes first; worker repair only on real evidence/design boundary. Full suite after settled changes, then reviewed clean candidate build and Sol sole headed controller.
Review exact final native matrix/oracles and portability/runtime; freeze only covered outcomes, keep named external deployment/business witnesses separately unproved.
decisionsWithoutOperatorWait: Roadmap print signature/time format and chief identity already approved.
D2 schedule/full pin and D3 save-kind/coalescing semantics already explicit; specify engineering details, do not reopen business consent.

Conservative maintenance thresholds, deterministic fixture sizes, version1.10, adapters/module split, escaped shared diffs and test allocation are ordinary technical decisions within the forthcoming bounded WO.
Do not add web login, remote server, HRM identity/group import or external provider/network access.
realAcceptanceBoundaries: Native Chrome+Edge print dialog V1 cannot be substituted by headless/PDF script. If inaccessible, report unresolved local acceptance criterion, not DONE.
Real runtime directory/adoption/recovery dialogs and defaultbrowser behavior need actual finalEXE proof; unavailable tools do not erase requirements.

Roadmap asks migration on a copy of realDB and D2 timing on yard machine. No real operational DB was inspected here. Synthetic migration proves local engineering only; document those as distinct deployment witnesses with owner/source-access need, never claim literal realDB/site-machine acceptance. Do not silently remove these rows to claim all original acceptance.
Physical printer may be replaced by actual Microsoft Print to PDF as roadmap explicitly permits; Excel desktop may be unavailable if file structures validated and limitation stated.
Python3.9 target needs actual runtime proof if retained; alternatively explicitly revise support matrix in design, not silently count syntax review as execution.
